question: §3 — does model choice (qwen2.5-coder 3b -> 7b) fix the real native-execution failures?
finding: 7b fixes the BORDERLINE tasks (wordwrap, glob: 1/2 -> 2/2) but NOT the hard-algorithmic ones (infix=operator-precedence parsing, lru=stateful eviction, topo=cycle-detecting topological sort: 0/2 on BOTH models). Model size is NOT the root cause for the hard class — the lever there is DECOMPOSITION / more independent-test-guided repair, not a bigger model. No failure reclassified as success; `verified` is the independent verifier's real verdict.
